    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionExecutionState
    Manual state in which the current player picks cards from the board rows.
    AnsiCodes
    Central repository of ANSI escape sequence fragments used by the TUI rendering layer.
    AppCoordinator
    Mediator between the network layer and the view layer.
    Artist
    Character card.
    BackspaceEvent
    Backspace keystroke.
    Board
    Immutable record holding all board components for a game session.
    BoardConfigLoader
    Strategy interface for loading board configuration from an external source.
    BoardDTO
    Immutable snapshot of the game board sent to clients on each game update.
    BoardRenderer
    Renders the central board block of the game screen into the FXML containers it is handed: the two card rows, the offer track, the turn-order tile, the face-down deck and the future-era building decks.
    BoardRenderer.Callbacks
    Game-state queries and input handling the renderer delegates back to the screen.
    BonusTotem
    Building that grants +1 bonus food when the owner places their totem on the order tile at the end of their action (Trigger.END_TURN).
    Builder
    Character card that reduces the food cost of buildings by discount and contributes pp prestige points at end-game (resolved in EndGameState).
    Building
    Abstract base for all building cards.
    BuildingBonus
    Transient per-player accumulator for building effects that must be resolved after they are set (e.g. end-of-turn bonuses, event modifiers).
    BuildingEffect
    Discriminator for the specific game effect applied by a Building subclass.
    Card
    Abstract base for all game cards (characters, events, buildings).
    CardCatalog
    Utility class for resolving card IDs to display information.
    CardDTO
    Immutable display data for a single card, sent to clients as part of BoardDTO or PlayerDTO.
    CardRow
    A fixed-size row of cards on the game board, split into two logical regions: Indices 0 .. numTribeCards-1 — tribe cards (characters and events). Indices numTribeCards .. size-1 — building cards. Null slots represent empty positions.
    CardToken
    String constants used to compose the typeLabel and effectsLabel fields of CardDTO.
    CardTokens
    Converts card token strings (produced server-side) to emoji for TUI display.
    CardType
    Classifies every card type used in the game.
    CavePaintings
    Event card: players with at least minArtists Artist cards gain multiplierPP PP per Artist; players below the threshold lose lostPP PP.
    ChalkBadge
    Small Christmas-Chalk number used as an overlay on deck-summary icons.
    Character
    Abstract base for all character cards (Hunter, Gatherer, Builder, Artist, Inventor, Shaman).
    CharInputEvent
    Printable character keystroke.
    CharMultiplier
    Building whose effect fires once at the end of the game (Trigger.END_GAME).
    Chip
    Token-style chips for food and PP.
    ClientApp
    Client entry point.
    ClientConnection
    Sent automatically when a client first establishes a connection to the server, before any login.
    ClientDisconnected
    Generated server-side when a client's connection is lost or closed (e.g. socket disconnect or RMI failure).
    ClientPing
    Sent periodically by the client as a heartbeat to let the server know it is still connected and responsive.
    ClientRequest
    Abstract base for all requests sent from client to server over the network.
    ConfirmEvent
    ENTER keystroke.
    ConnectingScreen
    Initial screen shown while waiting for the server to ask for login.
    ConnectingScreen
    Initial screen shown while the TUI waits for the server to confirm the connection and request login.
    ConnectionProvider
    Functional interface for obtaining a JDBC Connection.
    ControllerState
    Base class for all game-phase states in the GameController state machine.
    CreateGameRequest
    Sent when a client wants to create a new game lobby with a given number of players.
    DatabaseConfig
    Static JDBC configuration for the MySQL leaderboard database.
    DatabaseManager
    Initialises the MySQL database schema on server startup.
    DBRecord
    A single entry in the end-game leaderboard, returned by GameDAO.getLeaderboard() and broadcast to clients via GameEnded.
    Deck
    The draw pile used during a game.
    DisconnectedEvent
    Server event fired when the connection to the server is lost, either due to a timeout, an explicit server shutdown, or a network error.
    DisconnectedScreen
    GUI screen shown when the connection to the server is lost.
    DisconnectedScreen
    Shown whenever the server connection is lost.
    DuringEvent
    Abstract base for buildings whose effect activates during an event resolution (i.e. when one of Trigger.HUNT, Trigger.SHAMANIC_RITUAL, Trigger.SUSTENANCE, or Trigger.CAVE_PAINTINGS fires).
    DuringHunt
    Building that grants a bonus during the Hunt event: the owner gains +1 food and +1 PP per Hunter card they own (on top of the standard Hunt reward).
    DuringPaintings
    Building that grants +1 food per Artist card owned by the player during the CavePaintings event.
    DuringRitual
    Building that modifies the ShamanicRitual event for its owner.
    DuringSustenance
    Building that reduces the food cost during the Sustenance event by an amount equal to the number of cards the owner has of a specific character type (typeMultiplier).
    EndGame
    Building whose effect fires once at the end of the game (Trigger.END_GAME).
    EndGameEvent
    Server event fired when the game ends.
    EndGameObserver
    Observer notified when a game ends, either normally (with leaderboard data) or prematurely (all players left the lobby before starting, in which case results is null).
    EndGameScreen
    GUI end-game screen.
    EndGameScreen
    Displays the single-match standings on the left and the cumulative DB leaderboard on the right; when the DB is unavailable the right column is replaced by a red alert.
    EndGameScreen.RankedMatchRow
    Adapter that adds a client-side rank to MatchResult for the table.
    EndGameState
    Automatic state that resolves end-of-game scoring and persists results.
    EndRoundState
    Automatic state that executes end-of-round board maintenance.
    EnterGameRequest
    Sent when a client wants to join an existing game lobby identified by its id, for example one shown in a lobby list received via the home/lobby update flow.
    ErrorEvent
    Server event fired when the server rejects a request or reports an internal error.
    ErrorResponse
    Response sent by the server when a client request is rejected or an internal error occurs.
    Event
    Abstract base for event cards (Hunt, ShamanicRitual, Sustenance, CavePaintings).
    EventsOverlay
    Full-screen orange wash shown while end-of-round events resolve: a big title plus one line per player parsed from the server log message.
    EventsState
    Automatic state that resolves all event cards visible on the board.
    EventsTriggered
    Sent by the server once per resolved end-of-round event, immediately after the event's effect has been applied.
    EventsTriggeredEvent
    Server event fired once per resolved end-of-round event, carrying both the short title for the UI overlay and the longer per-player delta summary for the game log.
    EventVisitor<S>
    Visitor interface for dispatching ServerEvent subtypes to the correct view handler without instanceof checks.
    ExitGameRequest
    Sent when a client chooses to leave a game that is currently in progress (or has ended), returning the client to the home/lobby state.
    ExitLobbyRequest
    Sent when a client leaves the lobby of a game they have joined but that has not started yet, before StartGameRequest is sent.
    ExitScreen
    Marker screen that signals the GUI loop to terminate.
    ExitScreen
    Terminal state of the TUI state machine.
    ExtraMove
    Building that grants the owner an extra card draw from the upper row at the end of the round (Trigger.END_ROUND), handled by ExtraMoveState.
    ExtraMoveState
    State that handles the optional extra card draw granted by ExtraMove buildings at end of round.
    FakeServerConnection
    In-process fake server used for TUI testing.
    FloatingLog
    Bottom-right log used across screens.
    FxUtil
    Small JavaFX helpers shared by the game-screen sub-views: the selection glow, the disabled-card darken filter, the card-pile shadow, and image loaders that swallow failures so a missing asset never crashes a render.
    Game
    Core game model.
    GameController
    Per-game controller that owns the ControllerState state machine.
    GameDAO
    Data-access interface for match history persistence.
    GameDTO
    Immutable full snapshot of a game session sent to all clients after every state change.
    GameEnded
    Response broadcast to all players when a game ends.
    GameLogRestore
    Sent to a single client when it (re)joins a game in progress, carrying the full game-log transcript accumulated server-side.
    GameLogRestoreEvent
    Server event delivered to a (re)joining client carrying the full game-log transcript so the view can repopulate its local log after a disconnect or a fresh process restart.
    GameObserver
    Observer for in-game state changes.
    GamePersistenceManager
    Strategy interface for crash-recovery persistence of in-progress games.
    GameScreen
    Game screen — minimal, centered, responsive.
    GameScreen
    Main game screen, implemented as a non-blocking state machine that drives the stateless board/panel renderers in org.adsl.client.view.tui.game.
    GameSettings
    Immutable configuration values for a game session scaled to a specific player count.
    GameUI
    Abstract base for UI implementations (TUI and GUI).
    GameUpdate
    Response sent after every game-state change.
    GameUpdateEvent
    Server event carrying a full GameDTO snapshot after every game-state change.
    GameViewModel
    View-agnostic read model over a GameDTO snapshot for the local player.
    GameViewModel.MoveCounts
    Cards a player may pick from the top and low rows on their current turn.
    Gatherer
    Character card that reduces the food cost per character during the Sustenance event.
    GlyphLayout
    Pure (no-JavaFX) layout maths for the ChristmasChalk PNG bitmap font.
    GlyphLayout.Glyph
    Per-glyph metrics: advance pen step, image top-left bearingX/bearingTop.
    GlyphLayout.Metrics
    Parsed metrics.properties: oversampling scale, baseline ascent, and glyph table.
    GlyphLayout.Placement
    A glyph image's display-space top-left placement.
    GlyphStrip
    Composes a ChristmasChalk number from single-glyph PNGs (0–9, x, minus) so any value renders without a per-value asset and without a runtime JavaFX snapshot.
    GlyphStrip.Style
    A baked glyph style: its asset directory under /assets/.
    GUI
    JavaFX implementation of GameUI, parallel to TUI.
    GuiConstants
    Central registry of GUI layout constants for the JavaFX client.
    GUIScreen
    Base class for every GUI screen.
    Home
    Server-side "home screen" model that tracks the list of currently open games and notifies connected HomeObservers (i.e. clients in the lobby) whenever the game list changes.
    HomeObserver
    Observer notified when the list of open games in the server lobby changes.
    HomeScreen
    GUI home screen.
    HomeScreen
    Non-blocking home menu rendered with TextGraphics.
    HomeUpdate
    Response sent to clients on the home screen when the list of open games changes.
    HomeUpdateEvent
    Server event carrying the updated list of open game IDs when the home screen roster changes (game created or ended), along with per-game player lists and capacities for rich UI rendering.
    HostDisconnectedException
    Thrown by LobbyState when the game host disconnects, signalling that all remaining lobby players must be evicted.
    Hunt
    Event card: each player gains 1 food and multiplierPP PP per Hunter card they own.
    Hunter
    Character card.
    Icon
    Inventor card icons.
    ImageCatalog
    Central lookup for every PNG asset and the bundled Christmas Chalk font used by the GUI.
    InitGameState
    Automatic state that initialises the game board at the start of the first round, executed once per game after all players have picked their totems.
    InputEvent
    Abstract base for all keyboard input events produced by the TUI.
    InputEventVisitor
    Visitor interface for dispatching TUI keyboard input events to the current screen without instanceof checks.
    InvalidResponseException
    Thrown by ResponseVisitor implementations on the client side when a received ServerResponse is not valid in the current client state (e.g. a GameUpdate arriving while still on the home screen).
    Inventor
    Character card identified by an Icon.
    JsonBoardConfigLoader
    BoardConfigLoader implementation that reads game configuration from JSON resource files bundled in the classpath (/cards/, /offer_tiles.json, /order_tiles.json, /game_settings.json).
    JsonMessageHandler
    Utility class for JSON serialisation and deserialisation of network messages.
    Key
    Semantic keystroke produced by TuiTerminal.pollInput(), replacing Lanterna's KeyStroke.
    Key.Type
     
    LayoutMath
    Pure layout arithmetic shared by the responsive GUI.
    LobbyScreen
    GUI lobby screen.
    LobbyScreen
    Shows the players in the lobby as they join.
    LobbyState
    Manual state that manages the pre-game lobby.
    LobbyUpdate
    Response sent when the lobby roster changes.
    LobbyUpdateEvent
    Server event fired when the lobby roster changes (player joined or left).
    LoginNeeded
    Response sent immediately after a client connects (or after logout) to signal that it must authenticate with a LoginRequest before any other request is accepted.
    LoginNeededEvent
    Server event fired immediately after the client connects (or after logout) to signal that the user must enter a username before any other action.
    LoginRequest
    Sent when a client logs in with a chosen username, as part of the login flow handled by the server.
    LoginScreen
    Username entry.
    LoginScreen
    Collects the player's username inline in the TUI loop.
    LogoutRequest
    Sent when a logged-in client requests to log out, ending the session started by LoginRequest and returning the client to a logged-out state.
    MatchResult
    Final result of a single player at the end of a match, sent to clients as part of the end-game results (see GameEnded).
    Move
    Encodes a single card-pick or totem-placement action submitted by a client.
    MoveHintBar
    The hint row at the bottom of the game screen.
    MoveRequest
    Sent when a client performs one or more moves during their turn in an active game.
    NavigateDownEvent
    Arrow-down keystroke.
    NavigateLeftEvent
    Arrow-left keystroke.
    NavigateRightEvent
    Arrow-right keystroke.
    NavigateUpEvent
    Arrow-up keystroke.
    NoGameDAO
    No-op GameDAO used when the server starts without a reachable DBMS.
    OfferTile
    A single slot on the offer track.
    OfferTileDTO
    Immutable snapshot of a single offer-tile slot sent inside BoardDTO.
    OfferTrack
    The offer track: an ordered list of OfferTiles that defines both the available actions and the order in which players execute them.
    OrderCell
    A single slot on the OrderTile.
    OrderCellDTO
    Immutable snapshot of a single order-tile cell sent inside OrderTileDTO.
    OrderTile
    The turn-order track for a game session.
    OrderTileDTO
    Immutable snapshot of the turn-order tile sent inside BoardDTO.
    Phase
    Represents the current phase of a game round, stored in Game and included in GameDTO so clients can render the appropriate UI state.
    Player
    Represents a player in a game session.
    PlayerDTO
    Immutable snapshot of a player's state sent as part of GameDTO.
    PlayerPanelsRenderer
    Renders the player panels around the board: the local player's panel at the bottom and the opponents' panels along the top/left/right.
    RecoverState
    Manual state that waits for all players to reconnect after a server restart.
    RemoteClientStub
    RMI callback interface implemented by the client.
    RemoteClientStubImpl
    Client-side RMI callback object exported as a UnicastRemoteObject.
    RemoteServerService
    RMI server-side interface bound in the registry under the name "GameServer".
    RemoteServerServiceImpl
    RMI server-side endpoint.
    RequestVisitor<T>
    Visitor interface for dispatching ClientRequest subtypes without instanceof checks.
    ResponseVisitor
    Visitor interface for dispatching ServerResponse subtypes on the client side without instanceof checks.
    ResponsiveScaler
    Wraps a screen root in a centering holder that uniformly scales the content DOWN when the window is smaller than the content's laid-out size — the shared "never clip" fallback for every screen.
    RMIClientHandler
    VirtualClient implementation for RMI-connected clients.
    RMIServerConnection
    ServerConnection implementation that communicates with the server via Java RMI.
    Row
    Identifies which row of the board a Move targets.
    RulesOverlay
    The "?"
    Screen<S>
    Transport-independent base for a single game screen.
    SelectEvent
    SPACE keystroke (or equivalent secondary-select key).
    SerialGamePersistenceManager
    GamePersistenceManager that serialises Game objects to .ser files in a configurable directory.
    ServerApp
    Server entry point.
    ServerConnection
    Abstraction over the client-side network transport.
    ServerController
    Top-level server controller.
    ServerDisconnected
    Response sent by the server to notify the client that it has been forcefully disconnected (e.g. timeout or shutdown).
    ServerEvent
    Server-derived events handled by both view layers.
    ServerException
    Unchecked exception thrown by server-side game logic to signal a request that cannot be fulfilled (invalid state, wrong player, bad input).
    ServerPing
    Keep-alive response sent by the server in reply to a ClientPing.
    ServerResponse
     
    Shaman
    Character card that contributes starNum shaman stars during the ShamanicRitual event.
    ShamanicRitual
    Event card: players compare their total shaman-star count (sum of Shaman.getStarNum() plus any BuildingBonus.getExtraStars() bonus).
    SinceBuilt
    Building that reacts each time the owner draws a card (Trigger.DRAWING).
    SocketClientConnection
    ServerConnection implementation that communicates with the server via a TCP socket using newline-delimited JSON (same wire format as the server-side SocketClientHandler).
    SocketClientHandler
    VirtualClient implementation for socket-connected clients.
    SocketServer
    TCP server that listens for incoming client connections on the configured port and creates a SocketClientHandler for each accepted socket.
    SqlGameDAO
    MySQL implementation of GameDAO.
    StartGameRequest
    Sent by a client to start a game while still in its lobby, once enough players have joined.
    StateFactory
    Factory for reconstructing a ControllerState from a persisted Game after a server crash or restart.
    SummaryCardOverlay
    The "SC" summary-card button (bottom-left, next to the rules button) and the small flippable summary-card popup it toggles.
    Sustenance
    Event card: each player must pay 1 food per character card they own, reduced by 3 food per Gatherer and by any DuringSustenance discount.
    Totem
    Player totem colours.
    TotemAvailableEvent
    Server event fired during the totem-picking phase, broadcasting the list of totems still available for selection after each pick.
    TotemAvailableUpdate
    Response sent during the totem-picking phase after each player picks a totem, broadcasting the updated list of totems still available for selection.
    TotemPickingRequest
    Sent when a client picks their totem colour, typically during the game setup phase before play begins.
    TotemPickingScreen
    GUI screen for the totem-picking phase.
    TotemPickingScreen
    TUI screen for the totem-picking phase.
    TotemPickingState
    Manual state in which each player picks their totem colour before the game board is initialised.
    TotemPlacementState
    Manual state in which players, in turn-order, place their totem on an offer tile to choose their action for the round.
    Trigger
    Timing events used to activate card effects.
    TUI
    Text User Interface driven by an event queue and a state/visitor pattern.
    TuiBoardRenderer
    Stateless renderer for the central game board (header, card rows, offer track, order tile and the cursors that float over them).
    TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame
    Immutable per-frame description of everything the board renderer needs.
    TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame.CardCursor
    Active picking cursor over a card row.
    TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame.RowFocus
    Passive marker shown on the row being viewed when not actively picking.
    TuiCardWindows
    Full-screen TUI reference overlays: the paged rulebook viewer and the static summary card.
    TuiColor
    Standard 8-color ANSI palette.
    TuiDeckInspector
    Bottom-area overlay (toggled with the C key) that shows one player's full collection as card boxes.
    TuiEventsOverlay
    Draws the TUI end-of-round events overlay: a hatched orange wash over the board area with the event title and one centered line per player parsed from the server log message.
    TuiGameLog
    Shared, in-memory history of server-pushed game messages for the TUI.
    TuiLegendOverlay
    Static symbol-legend overlay (toggled with the L key): a boxed panel pinned to the top-right corner listing the meaning of every glyph used on the board.
    TuiPlayerPanels
    Stateless renderer for the per-player summary panels shown below the board: the local player's tribe line plus the compact "OTHERS" rows.
    TUIScreen
    Base abstract class for all TUI screens.
    TuiSize
    Immutable terminal dimensions, mirroring the Lanterna TerminalSize shape used throughout the TUI screens.
    TuiSummaryChunks
    Pure builder of the compact per-player card-summary fragments shown in the TUI game screen (the "N HUNTER", "N BUILDER: 🌟:x,🍖:-y", "│ BUILDINGS: …" pieces).
    TuiSummaryChunks.Chunk
    Tagged text fragment: when highlight is true it renders in the player's totem color.
    TuiTerminal
    Thin abstraction over a JLine Terminal that mirrors the subset of the Lanterna Screen API used by the existing TUI screens: TuiTerminal.clear(), TuiTerminal.getTerminalSize(), TuiTerminal.newTextGraphics(), TuiTerminal.refresh() and non-blocking input via TuiTerminal.pollInput().
    TuiText
    Pure text helpers for the terminal UI: terminal-column width that accounts for emoji (wide / with variation selector) and box-drawing glyphs, padding to a visible width, and word-wrapping.
    TuiTextGraphics
    Drop-in replacement for Lanterna's TextGraphics that emits ANSI escape sequences into a shared StringBuilder owned by the TuiTerminal.
    VirtualClient
    Transport-agnostic representation of a connected client on the server side.
